SELECT: n.primary_name, a.actor_movie_count, ROUND(a.actor_avg_rating, 2) AS actor_avg_rating, d.director_movie_count, ROUND(d.director_avg_rating, 2) AS director_avg_rating
FROM: actor_works a JOIN director_works d ON a.name_id = d.name_id JOIN names n ON a.name_id = n.id

CTE_actor_works.SELECT: p.name_id, AVG(t.average_rating) AS actor_avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS actor_movie_count
CTE_actor_works.FROM: principals p JOIN titles t ON p.title_id = t.id
CTE_actor_works.WHERE: p.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') AND t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL

CTE_director_works.SELECT: p.name_id, AVG(t.average_rating) AS director_avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS director_movie_count
CTE_director_works.FROM: principals p JOIN titles t ON p.title_id = t.id
CTE_director_works.WHERE: p.category_id = 'director' AND t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
